title: BM78xBT overlay skin.json
description: Declarative config for an overlay skin under web/skins/<name>/.

name.description: Skin name; should match the folder name.

renderer.description: Use the built-in generic LCD renderer instead of a script file.

digits.description: Number of 7-seg digit cells (text-based skins can omit this).

digit_prefix.description: Segment ids are <digit_prefix><d>_<seg> (required only with digits).

no_dp.description: Digit indexes that have no decimal-point element (e.g. the rightmost digit).

unit.description: Unit -> element id map (keys: V, A, Ω, S, F, Hz, %, %4~20mA, °C, °F).

prefix.description: Unit -> prefix -> element id map. Prefix ids are shared across units.

icons.description: Annunciator key -> element id (hold, relative, auto, auto_hold, crest, record, max, min, avg).

hidden.description: Element ids the skin owns but never drives.

map.description: Function name -> element id(s). Shared ids light for every function listing them.

id.description: Element whose textContent shows the function name.

function_labels.description: Per-function display overrides for text-type function labels.

rtc_label.description: Element whose textContent shows the timestamp.

unit_labels.description: Non-exclusive unit label lookup: '<prefix>|<unit>' -> label (e.g. 'm|V' -> 'mV'). Used by text-based skins like fn_text.

right_aligned.description: Function names whose reading is right-aligned (built-in LCD renderer).
